why_use_section.title: Why We Engineer with React
why_use_section.subtitle: React provides the declarative power needed to build complex, data-driven interfaces with ease.
paragraphs: React is our foundational choice for building dynamic web experiences. By utilizing a declarative programming model and a Virtual DOM, we minimize expensive direct browser manipulations, resulting in highly performant applications that scale seamlessly regardless of UI complexity.

The true strength of React lies in its component-based ecosystem. This modular approach allows our teams to build encapsulated units of code that manage their own state, enabling better reusability, easier testing, and significantly cleaner handoffs between designers and engineers.
